title: Inde Navarrette on Meeting Pamela Anderson, Hosting ‘SNL’ and X-Men Stunt Training
content:
“Obsession” starInde Navarrettehad quite the busy weekend, going from the Academy Museum Gala on Saturday to the Newport Beach Film Festival on Sunday.

Navarrette attended the festival, which runs until Thursday in Newport Beach, as one ofVariety’s 10 Actors to Watch,who were celebrated during the festival’s Honor Brunch.

While speaking withVariety’sMarc Malkin at the festival’s carpet, Navarrette said attending the gala was “amazing.” “I mean, you’re just overwhelmed and kind of drowning in everybody that you have looked up to, possibly ever, and it’s just so lovely meeting people and the reception that ‘Obsession’ has been getting… I’m just so honored to go and be with the members of the Academy and just get an inside scoop on what that magnificent world is like.”

Jessica Lange and Pamela Anderson were two of the actresses Navarrette was excited to see Saturday night. “I spoke to Jessica Lange, who is an icon,” she said. “[And] the way that Pamela carries herself with such grace and honesty and just pure creativity and love is just exactly who I want to be.”

And Navarrette’s schedule isn’t slowing down just yet — she’s set tohostthis year’s “Saturday Night Live” Halloween episode with musical guest Gracie Abrams.

“I literally I feel like I snuck in,” joked the actress. “I’m super excited to keep everything under wraps because I really truly want to make this super fun for the audience. And what I love is when I don’t know anything. So I’m really excited to be working with the writers.”

Also on the horizon is the MCU’s forthcoming “X-Men” film, in which she’ll play Rogue. Navarrette told Malkin she hasn’t corresponded directly with Anna Paquin, who originated the role, but feels “the correspondence started when I was younger, when I really fell in love with the ‘X-Men’ movies in the first place.”

On the topic of stunt training for the superhero film, Navarrette said it’s a good excuse to get herself in the gym. “I’ve always wanted to take part in that sort of a thing,” she said. “I think it’s also a really good excuse to get in the gym. I’m the laziest person, and I am very excited to get up and move my body.”

Inde Navarrette praises Jessica Lange and Pamela Anderson as “icons” after meeting them at the Academy Museum Gala.📍 Newport Beach Film Festivalpic.twitter.com/5Wz8BXoxBy
title_zh: 印德·納瓦雷特(Inde Navarrette)談到與帕梅拉·安德森(Pamela Anderson)的會面、主持《周六夜現場》(SNL)以及《X戰警》(X-Men)的特技訓練。
content_zh:
《癡迷(Obsession)》的明星印迪·納瓦雷特(Inde Navarrette)在週末相當忙碌，從週六的學院博物館晚會到週日的紐波特海灘電影節。

納瓦雷特參加了這個將持續到週四的電影節，並被評選為《綜藝(Variety)》的10位值得關注的演員之一，並在電影節的榮譽早午餐中受到慶祝。

在電影節的紅毯上，納瓦雷特與《綜藝》的馬克·馬爾金(Marc Malkin)交談時表示，參加晚會的經歷“太棒了”。她說：“我的意思是，你會感到不知所措，彷彿淹沒在所有你一直仰望的人當中，這真是太美好了，能夠見到這些人，以及《癡迷》所獲得的反響……我真的很榮幸能夠參加，與學院的成員們在一起，並了解那個壯麗世界的內幕。”

傑西卡·蘭芝(Jessica Lange)和帕梅拉·安德森(Pamela Anderson)是納瓦雷特週六晚上期待見到的兩位女演員。她說：“我和傑西卡·蘭芝交談過，她是一位偶像。”她補充道：“而帕梅拉以如此優雅、誠實和純粹的創造力與愛心展現自己，正是我想成為的那個人。”

而納瓦雷特的日程表還沒有放慢的跡象——她將主持今年的《週六夜現場(Saturday Night Live)》萬聖節特輯，音樂嘉賓是格雷西·艾布拉姆斯(Gracie Abrams)。

這位女演員開玩笑說：“我真的覺得我像是偷偷溜進來的。”她表示：“我非常興奮能夠保密，因為我真的想讓觀眾感到這次活動非常有趣。而我喜歡的是當我什麼都不知道的時候。所以我真的很期待和編劇們一起工作。”

此外，她還將參演漫威電影宇宙即將上映的《X戰警(X-Men)》電影，並飾演羅格(Rogue)。納瓦雷特告訴馬爾金，她尚未與最早飾演該角色的安娜·帕奎因(Anna Paquin)直接聯繫，但她感覺“這種聯繫在我年輕的時候就開始了，當時我真的愛上了《X戰警》電影。”

談到為這部超級英雄電影進行特技訓練時，納瓦雷特表示這是一個很好的藉口讓自己去健身房。“我一直想參加這樣的活動，”她說。“我覺得這也是一個很好的藉口去健身房。我是最懶惰的人，但我非常期待能夠起身活動我的身體。”

印迪·納瓦雷特在學院博物館晚會上遇見傑西卡·蘭芝和帕梅拉·安德森後，讚揚她們為“偶像”。📍 紐波特海灘電影節
